claims.claim_text: 估出近期約 32% 的論文疑似機器代筆、2026 年初一度逼近 39%，相較 ChatGPT 出現前的 0.4% 基準；電腦科學高達 65%，數學卻只有 0.7%
claims.evidence: climbs in two waves to about 32% over the most recent complete quarter ... peaking near 39% in early 2026 ... at a threshold calibrated so pre-ChatGPT papers flag at 0.4% ... Computer science leads at about 65% ... Mathematics is lowest, near 0.7%
claims.note: Every numeric figure matches the source verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 數學論文滿是符號、散文極少，本來就落在偵測器的分布之外，低分到底是「沒人用 AI」還是「偵測器根本看不出來」，這份資料無法分辨
claims.evidence: Mathematics papers are dominated by notation and theorem-proof structure, and once equations and references are removed the remaining prose is sparse and unlike the scientific English the detector was trained on ... a low score in mathematics is weak evidence that a human wrote the paper ... The result is consistent with two very different explanations, lower adoption or reduced detector sensitivity.
claims.note: The author's own stated caveat; the lede's framing matches, not inflated.

claims.claim_text: 一路推到 85.3 GFLOPS——理論峰值 134.4 GFLOPS 的 63.5%
claims.evidence: O melhor modelo, MX24, sustentou 85.30 GFLOPS ... O pico teórico é calculado como 2 portas FMA × 8 floats × 2 ops × 4,2 GHz = 134,4 GFLOPS ... 85.30 ... 63.5%
claims.note: Final GFLOPS, theoretical peak, and efficiency percentage all match.

claims.claim_text: 從最樸素的 ijk 三重迴圈約 1.5 GFLOPS ... 過程試了 28 種配置
claims.evidence: Foram testadas 28 configurações distintas (modelos MX01 a MX28) ... superando a implementação ingênua por um fator de 56,5×
claims.note: 28 configs stated verbatim. The '約 1.5 GFLOPS' baseline is not stated as a literal number but is the direct arithmetic consequence of the source's 56.5× factor over the confirmed 85.30 GFLOPS result (85.30 / 56.5 = 1.51); the lede hedges with '約', matching the source's strength.

claims.claim_text: stream store 只剩 1.24 GFLOPS，8-line blocking 因暫存器溢位掉到 12 GFLOPS
claims.evidence: stream stores: 1.24 GFLOPS ... 8-line blocking: 12.24 ... Necessita 64 registradores YMM; 48 são spilled
claims.note: Stream-store 1.24 exact; 8-line blocking source value 12.24, lede rounds to '12 GFLOPS' (deflation-safe rounding, register-spill cause confirmed).

claims.claim_text: 讓 Claude Opus 4.8 在 Rocq 定理證明器裡形式化並驗證 nftables 的 userspace，靠一個「一個 LLM 生成、另一個 LLM 挑錯」的對抗迴圈，覆蓋了約 90% 的規則語言
claims.evidence: All code and proofs were generated by Claude CLI running in auto mode, with Opus 4.8 as the model ... Development proceeded through an adversarial loop between two LLMs: one wrote the specification, implementation, and proofs, and the other reviewed them ... ~90% of the nftables rule language modeled and verified.
claims.note: Model (Opus 4.8), adversarial two-LLM loop, and ~90% coverage all confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 揪出兩個從 2022 年起存在於每個 Linux 版本的 bug：一個把 tcp flags 的位元遮罩最佳化成精確比對，悄悄把「拒絕」變成「放行」 ... 那個 bitmask bug——純靠 LLM 亂槍打鳥找不到，非得形式驗證才逼得出來
claims.evidence: we uncovered two critical bugs affecting every version of Linux since 2022 ... the bug converts a restrictive policy into a permissive one, changing from bit-testing to exact-match semantics ... Unlike the 3 silent bugs that the LLM did manage to find just through eyeballing the buggy output rules, the bitmask bug requires a deeper understanding of the meaning of nftables semantics.
claims.note: Two bugs since 2022, reject->accept bitmask semantics, and the formal-verification-necessity framing all supported.

claims.claim_text: 最省事的是把 effort 直接寫進 system prompt（GPT-5.6、gpt-oss 就這樣做）... 重點是效益會飽和——最高 effort 常常只換來成本上升、準確率卻打平
claims.evidence: we know that OpenAI allows us to toggle the reasoning effort setting via the system prompt ... the gpt-oss chat template inserts the selected reasoning effort into the system message ... Presumably, their GPT 5 models, including the recent GPT 5.6 models, use a similar approach ... performance would saturate at some point ... diminishing returns at the highest GPT-5.6 settings.
claims.note: System-prompt method (gpt-oss confirmed; GPT-5.6 hedged as 'presumably/similar approach' in source — lede's grouping is acceptable) and saturation both supported.

claims.claim_text: 用 information bottleneck 給了個乾淨的解釋 ... 頻寬無限時兩者等價，真正的優勢只在頻寬受限、壓縮掉冗餘時才出現 ... relay 一旦有資訊損失，較強的模型反而因壓縮而變差。跨五個 benchmark、三種模型規模的實驗支持這個框架
claims.evidence: We formalize this trade-off as an information bottleneck controlled by an effective parameter β ... under infinite relay bandwidth, any SAS can be simulated by a MAS ... Thus, the nontrivial advantage of MAS arises under bounded relays ... MAS consistently helps when relays are near-sufficient, especially for weaker models. In contrast, MAS gains shrink or reverse when relays incur information loss, especially for stronger models ... 18 controlled experiments across five benchmarks and three model scales.
claims.note: Framework, equivalence-under-infinite-bandwidth, stronger-model regression, and five-benchmark/three-scale experiments all verbatim in abstract.

claims.claim_text: 在 64 位系統上就用標準 64-bit 指標、維持原本 ABI，把 capability 的邊界資訊藏在物件外的 aux 配置裡 ... 約 4 倍執行開銷——比早期 SideCaps 的約 200 倍、MonoCaps 的約 10 倍好得多，也換來 CHERI ... 做不到的 ABI 相容與 union 支援
claims.evidence: InvisiCaps allow for 64-bit pointers on 64-bit systems ... the C program just sees the intval portion of pointers ... reduction of performance overhead to about 4x in the bad cases ... Fil-C was 200x slower than normal C [SideCaps] ... MonoCaps reduced the perf overhead of Fil-C to about 10x ... Unlike CHERI, InvisiCaps are more compatible (pointers are 64-bit, not 128-bit or 256-bit) ... InvisiCaps allow for meaningful union usage.
claims.note: 4x / 200x / 10x overhead figures, 64-bit ABI, aux-allocation bounds, and CHERI union-support contrast all confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 「real form controls meet soft-body physics」... 一套無相依的 Web Components，一包 40 個自訂元件、接一個 script 標籤就能用，還內建 WCAG AA 色彩 token、深色模式與 RTL 支援
claims.evidence: Real form controls meet soft-body physics, with dark mode, right-to-left support and WCAG AA color tokens built in ... 0 dependencies 40 custom elements 1 script tag WCAG AA Dark mode RTL
claims.note: Tagline, 0 deps, 40 elements, 1 script tag, WCAG AA / dark mode / RTL all verbatim on the page.

claims.claim_text: 揭露橫跨四家 coding agent（Cursor、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、Antigravity）的七個沙箱逃逸 ... 透過 Docker socket 拿到 RCE（GHSA-v4xv-rqh3-w9mc）
claims.evidence: seven sandbox escapes across four coding agents ... Cursor ... Codex (CLI) ... Gemini CLI ... Antigravity ... a sandboxed writer can hand executable config to an unsandboxed reader, the boundary has a hole in it ... GHSA-v4xv-rqh3-w9mc ... A privileged local daemon became an unsandboxed execution environment.
claims.note: Count (7), four named agents, core pattern, and the Docker-socket GHSA id all confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 它每 128 bit 只做 8 bit 的 Hamming 修正 ... 而不是取代主機板端那種真 ECC。他引 Mozilla 的資料指出約 15% 的 Firefox 當機源自 RAM 硬體錯誤，而最完整的公開研究卻還停在 2009 年的 DDR／DDR2
claims.evidence: specified as 8 bits of error correction per 128 bits of data which implies basic Hamming codes ... The on-die ECC is not a replacement for regular ECC, it's a mitigation for new problems introduced ... Mozilla's claim that 15% of Firefox crashes are due to RAM hardware errors ... the best published research on the effectiveness of ECC on RAM errors is the Google paper published in 2009 which is based on DDR and DDR2 RAM.
claims.note: 8-bit/128-bit Hamming, mitigation-not-replacement, 15% Firefox, and 2009 Google DDR/DDR2 study all verbatim.

claims.claim_text: MCP 管的是 agent 對「工具」的呼叫，A2A ... 透過發佈在固定 URL 的 Agent Card 探索彼此，ACP 則是走 REST-first 的 agent 溝通、現已併入 A2A
claims.evidence: MCP: agent to tool communication ... discovers a capable peer via its Agent Card (published at a well-known URL) ... ACP: agent to agent communication over REST (merged into A2A). ACP took a REST-first approach ... In production, MCP and A2A are complementary.
claims.note: MCP=tool, A2A Agent Card at well-known URL, ACP REST-first merged into A2A, and complementary-in-production all confirmed.
